items.title: watchOS 27.3 Brings Live Rewind and Siri Recap to Apple Watch
items.excerpt: With the first beta of watchOS 27.3, Apple is introducing new Audio Intelligence features it previewed for the Apple Watch Series 12 and Ultra 4 earlier this year. Powered by the S11 chip, Audio Intelligence includes Live Rewind, Siri Recap, Sound Recognition, and Shazam Music Recognition. Sound Recognition and Shazam are already on the watch, but Live Rewind and Siri Recap are now available in the beta. Live Rewind can show you a transcript of the last 15 seconds of a conversation.

items.title: iPadOS 27.3 Expands Siri Mode to Camera App
items.excerpt: iOS 27 added a Siri tab to the Camera app on the iPhone 15 Pro and newer for convenient access to Visual Intelligence. Starting with iPadOS 27.3, which is in beta starting today, that feature has expanded to iPad Pro and iPad Air models with the M1 chip and newer, as well as the iPad mini models with the A17 Pro and A20 Pro chips. When you switch to Siri mode in the Camera app on supported iPhone or iPad models, you can get information about things around you.

items.title: AI robots apparently can't do nothing: They start working even without instructions
items.excerpt: Six AI-powered robot models were tasked with performing activities in a simulation – but even without receiving any instructions, all of them started moving. Five systems even independently carried out tasks that nobody had asked them to perform. Researchers see this as a previously underestimated safety vulnerability in autonomous robots and demonstrate why even a simple stop command isn't a reliable solution.
